title: OmniAlign: A Unified Multilingual Aligner for Word and Sentence Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2608.18474v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cross-lingual sequence alignment is fundamental for building and exploiting parallel corpora, spanning mappings from documents and sentences down to words and subwords. Existing tools, however, typically specialize in a single granularity, so practitioners often need separate systems for word- and sentence-level alignment---especially in multilingual and long-text settings. We present OmniAlign, a unified multilingual aligner that supports both word-level and sentence-level alignment with a single lightweight model. Built on an encoder-only backbone with strong long-context modeling, OmniAlign induces word alignments from contextualized token similarity matrices, and obtains document-level $m$--$n$ sentence alignments via sentence embeddings combined with dynamic programming. To balance fine-grained alignment accuracy and sentence-representation quality, we use a four-stage training pipeline: alignment-oriented continued pre-training, se

translated_title: OmniAlign：一种用于词级和句级对齐的统一多语言对齐器
translated_abstract: 跨语言序列对齐是构建和利用平行语料库的基础，涵盖从文档和句子到词和子词的映射。然而，现有工具通常专注于单一粒度，因此从业者往往需要为词级和句级对齐分别使用不同的系统——尤其是在多语言和长文本场景中。我们提出了OmniAlign，一种统一的多语言对齐器，能够用单个轻量级模型同时支持词级和句级对齐。基于具有强大长上下文建模能力的编码器主干，OmniAlign从上下文相关的词元相似度矩阵中诱导词级对齐，并通过句子嵌入结合动态规划获得文档级的$m$--$n$句级对齐。为了平衡细粒度对齐准确性和句子表示质量，我们采用了一个四阶段的训练流程：面向对齐的持续预训练、后续阶段（未完整提供）。
tldr: OmniAlign是一个统一的多语言对齐器，通过单个轻量模型同时支持词级和句级对齐，解决了现有工具粒度单一的问题。
en_tdlr: OmniAlign is a unified multilingual aligner that supports both word-level and sentence-level alignment with a single lightweight model, addressing the granularity-specific limitations of existing tools.
